entries.zh: 无买主；拍卖时无人出价承买（「下手」即应买之人）
entries.en: no buyer appears for the thing; none comes forward to bid and take it
entries.notes: 西语栏与官话栏均有[残]；依汉字「無下手」、闽南栏音写与官话残文 comprador 判为无买主，kurto 一段无法辨读。

entries.zh: 不如人；比不上别人，相形见绌
entries.en: not to measure up to others; inferior to others

entries.zh: 嫌弃拒收：看不上眼而不肯要
entries.en: to reject on sight; to refuse and turn away what is offered or paid
entries.notes: 闽南栏「quiağ」声调标记 T99 污损；字义依汉字「見却」与西语栏互证。

entries.zh: 却、退回不收：不肯接受所出之价或所荐之人
entries.en: to refuse, to decline; not to accept the price offered or those who offer

entries.zh: 不甘心、不肯服气
entries.en: not reconciled; unwilling to accept a loss or refusal

entries.zh: 嫌弃拒收：不肯接受来价、来货
entries.en: to refuse those who offer; to reject the price or goods offered
entries.notes: 闽南栏声调标记 T99 污损；字义依汉字「見却」与西语栏互证。

entries.zh: 没有脸面、羞于见人；不知所为宜
entries.en: to have no face, to be ashamed to show oneself; not to know what is proper

entries.zh: 没有学问、不学无术
entries.en: to have no learning; unlettered, ignorant

entries.zh: 无法预知、不得而知（袂了得）
entries.en: cannot know or make out; not to foresee what tomorrow brings
entries.notes: 声调标记 T99；释义依西语栏「不知明日之事」与闽南栏音写。

entries.zh: 不自量力、不知自己斤两
entries.en: not to know one's own measure; to overreach oneself

entries.zh: 不可预测、料想不到（不测）
entries.en: unforeseeable, beyond conjecture; a contingency
entries.notes: 声调标记 T99；释义依西语栏「不能推测」与汉字「不測」。

entries.zh: 生疏、感情疏远（生分）
entries.en: estranged; to grow unfamiliar, no longer to know one another

entries.zh: 无话可说、答不上来
entries.en: speechless; to have no answer, not to know how to reply

entries.zh: 被问而一概不知、什么都答不上
entries.en: not to know anything one is asked; unable to answer whatever is put to one
entries.notes: 首字「罕/寧」原稿存疑（[疑]）；释义依西语栏「被问而不知」与闽南栏 chay chay。

entries.zh: 殊不知、竟不知其相反
entries.en: little does one know; not to know to the contrary
entries.notes: 第三音节声调标记 T99；字义依汉字「殊不知」与西语栏互证。

entries.zh: 无买主：货无人承买、拍卖无人应价
entries.en: no buyer comes forward for the merchandise; the sale finds no taker

entries.zh: 不成、办不成；谈不拢
entries.en: not to come off; not to succeed with it

entries.zh: 没有见识、缺乏阅历
entries.en: to have no knowledge of the world; lacking insight and experience
entries.notes: 声调标记两处 T99；字义清楚，西语栏「no se conosce el」略残讹。

entries.zh: 事不圆成、目的未达成
entries.en: the effect is not obtained; the matter does not come to completion

entries.zh: 无踪影、遍寻不见
entries.en: no trace to be found; nowhere to be found
entries.notes: 声调标记 T99，且「精影」疑为「蹤影」之讹；释义依西语栏「寻不见」。

entries.zh: 无与伦比、无可比拟
entries.en: incomparable; beyond compare
entries.notes: 声调标记 T99；古义依西语栏「无可相比」定为无与伦比，非现代「没品」义。

entries.zh: 不能相比、比不得
entries.en: not to be compared; cannot be matched
entries.notes: 声调两处 T99，闽南栏尾部 mim dixa 与西语栏尾部残讹无法辨识；释义仅据首三音节（袂比得）。
